description: Top 3 brokers for a trader's country, the same answer as /api/v1/recommend: forex.mobile's ranking, limited to brokers whose own restricted-countries list was read and does not exclude the country, ordered by the chosen priority. priority: spreads (lowest published spread, the default), deposit (lowest published minimum), regulation (most top-tier retail licences); anything else uses the overall ranking. Broker scores are forex.mobile's editorial ratings out of 5, written by a named reviewer from each broker's published terms, regulator records and Trustpilot ratings. Spreads, deposits and platforms are the figures each broker publishes; forex.mobile does not trade real money with brokers or measure live spreads or execution. Methodology: https://forex.mobile/methodology

country.description: Country slug (e.g. uae, vietnam, us) or two-letter ISO code. Slugs: uae, saudi-arabia, kuwait, egypt, india, australia, uk, canada, nigeria, south-africa, france, singapore, us-traders, vietnam, thailand, philippines, indonesia, malaysia, japan, hong-kong, pakistan, kazakhstan, mongolia, ghana, bangladesh, kenya, morocco, tanzania, brazil, colombia, germany, italy, spain, netherlands, sweden, switzerland, sri-lanka, qatar, mexico

experience.description: Echoed back; it does not change the order
